newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Goias reaches debt accord with govt -report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Goias reaches debt accord with govt -report.

text.p: The Brazilian state of Goias has reached an agreement with the Finance Ministry on its debt of 900 million reais, private Invest News agency said.
Under the accord, the state's debt will now be reduced to 200 million reais, with the remaining 700 million reais to be be assumed by the federal government.

The 700 million comprises of 400 million reais costs when Goias was split to allow for the formation of the state of Tocantins and 300 million spent in the state bank's mortgage portfolio, Invest News said.
Finance Ministry officials were not available to comment on the report. ((-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
